failurePaths.midStepError: Synthetic free-cost Discover followed by failure commits no discovery, shuffle, or draw; committed state hash and published events are unchanged.
failurePaths.reloadRestart: Synthetic X and Discover prompts serialize/replay with stable IDs; actual desktop/mobile reloads both prompts, cancellable sacrifice payment, and settled outcomes.
failurePaths.partialWrite: Suspended resolution preserves committed deck/hand/RNG; fatal resolution after accepted choices rolls back the entire step. No new persistence schema or asynchronous write is introduced.
failurePaths.invalidStaleInput: Out-of-range/foreign answers and stale consumed prompt IDs bounce; the same card answer cannot commit twice.
failurePaths.concurrentActors: A foreign answer and opponent battle action bounce while the human resolving prompt is owed; existing session writer serialization remains the persistence boundary.
